maya: Partner (SecureLayer) asks for marketplace listing + KMS connector + SSO/SCIM quickstart. Target public demo 2026-06-07. Can eng call out blockers?

diego: SAML + SCIM OK. Need mapping table for groups->roles and SCIM bulk behavior differences. Recommend testing with Okta and Azure AD.

rachel: Security needs HSM attestation file and confirmation of PKCS#11 compatibility for BYOK import. Also require audit-event schema for key import/rotate/revoke.

partners-pm: Legal wants co-marketing copy by 2026-05-28. Partner can provide attestation by 2026-05-20 but may be late.

maya: If attestation delayed we can list integration as "preview" but hide BYOK step. Is that acceptable?

rachel: Preview ok but must include clear disclaimers. Also open GH issue for SCIM group delta audit gaps.

diego: I'll push a tiny SCIM/SAML harness and a CSV-role parser snippet tonight. Will include curl examples.

sec-bot: Task assigned: scim-harness -> @diego (due 1768504320).

maya: Action list: diego -> harness, rachel -> security checklist + matrix, partners-pm -> attestation & legal. Reconvene 2026-05-22 if attestation missing. Thanks!
